title: "purpose": "Entity-relations specification for The Logotic Technique Catalogue v1.0 (EA-LTC-01)."
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
This JSON sidecar is the outbound provenance graph for *The Logotic Technique Catalogue*. It defines the catalogue as a subject node, enumerates cited works, source software, external research, and newly minted concepts, and connects them through a custom typed-edge vocabulary including EXTENDS, RESPONDS_TO, IMPLEMENTS, DIAGNOSES, ADAPTS, DEFINES, and ANCHORS. It was designed for ingestion into the Aperture Atlas, a Forward Library, a Concordance Engine, Neo4j, or equivalent JSON-LD tooling.

The object is not the Catalogue’s prose argument. It is a structured companion that makes its dependencies and conceptual outputs traversable. The body still uses pending DOI identifiers and contains dated “forthcoming” relations, so it requires a post-publication reconciliation pass before machine ingestion. The registry’s current title is a malformed extraction of the `_about_this_file.purpose` value and must be replaced.

wiki_article:
**The Entity-Relations Specification for The Logotic Technique Catalogue** is a machine-readable graph sidecar authored by Lee Sharks.

The JSON object identifies the Catalogue and maps its relation to earlier Crimson Hexagonal Archive works, the PurpleAILAB Decepticon repository, external red-team research, and concepts introduced or formalized in the Catalogue. These include the Critique Loop, Basin Hardening Cycle, Concordance Engine, Frame Concession, Witness Preposition, Logotic Inversion, cooperative patterns, defensive valence, and semantic minting.

Each node has an identifier, type, label, and role. Edges specify whether the Catalogue cites, extends, responds to, implements, adapts, diagnoses, or defines another object. The sidecar is intended to support graph ingestion and audit of the publication’s provenance.

At the frozen commit, several identifiers remain pending and some relations describe future implementation. The file should therefore be updated only through explicit versioning after the Catalogue DOI and successor deposits are confirmed.
